newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Activcard Easdaq IPO priced at $8 a share.
newsitem.headline: Activcard Easdaq IPO priced at $8 a share.

text.p: The initial public offering of French smart card maker ActivCard SA on Easdaq, Europe's new growth stocks market, has been priced at $8 a share, lead manager Hambrecht & Quist Saint Dominique said on Monday.
On Saturday, ActivCard announced that the indicative price for the IPO had been lowered to $8-$10 from $10-$12 originally and that the offer would be extended until December 16.

A spokeswoman at the French broker told Reuters on Monday it had been decided the shares would be offered at the discounted final issue price of $8 in view of the poor climate in equity markets generally over the past few days.
The three-million-share issue is being co-managed by Belgium's KB Securities and Britain's Beeson Gregory, and the shares are due to begin trading on Easdaq on December 20.
